description: This file is a PHP source script for the TestLink project, responsible for exporting platform data associated with test projects into an XML format. It manages initialization, fetches data from the database, and outputs an XML file.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for dynamic web page display within TestLink environment.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class representing input parameters for request validation and extraction.

classes.name: tlDBObject
classes.description: Class responsible for database-related operations, such as fetching table names.

classes.name: ADODB_XML
classes.description: Third-party class for converting database query results into XML format.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates arguments from the request, fetching test project info and setting defaults.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI configuration object for the export page, including filename, titles, and URLs.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs data export for the specified project, generating an XML string from database data and initiating download.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for viewing platform data in a specific project.
